meta.title: Langmuir Probe Diagnostic Systems
meta.description: XHINS single/double/triple and emissive Langmuir probes scan I–V to obtain electron density/temperature, plasma/floating potential, and EEDF; RF filtering, cooling, and 3D motion options; multiple flange interfaces.
page.title: Langmuir Probes
page.lead: Scan I–V to get n_e, T_e, V_p, V_f, and EEDF. Single/double/triple/emissive probes with optional RF filter, cooling, and 3D motion modules.
single.title: Single Langmuir Probe (XHINS-SLP)
single.tagline: General plasma diagnostics covering multiple probe forms
single.overview: Measures electron/ion density, electron temperature, plasma/floating potential, and EEDF via I–V scans. Supports cylindrical/planar/spherical probes with RF filtering, cooling, and 3D motion platforms.
single.feature1: Measures n_e, n_i, T_e, V_p, V_f, EEDF
single.feature3: Scan modes: linear/triangle/step with auto scan & averaging
single.feature4: Materials W/Mo/Ta; sheaths Al2O3/BN/quartz; motion stages available

double.title: Double Langmuir Probe (XHINS-DLP)
double.tagline: Self-referenced, robust in floating or noisy environments
double.overview: Symmetric bias and current between two probes to get n_e, n_i, T_e, and EEDF when ground reference is absent/remote. Suitable for atmospheric jets, floating devices, and strong-noise setups.
double.feature1: Reduced ground dependence, strong noise immunity
double.feature2: Measures n_e, n_i, T_e; post-process for EEDF
double.feature4: High-sensitivity current chain and sheath options

triple.title: Triple Langmuir Probe (XHINS-TLP)
triple.tagline: Parallel three-channel capture for transient diagnostics
triple.overview: Three identical probes sample simultaneously to capture transient n_e and T_e within discharge cycles. Ideal for pulsed discharges and transient thruster studies.
triple.feature1: Three-channel synchronous acquisition for transient/pulse events
triple.feature2: Less reliance on full I–V scans, faster sampling
triple.feature4: High-bandwidth and filtering options for better SNR

emissive.title: Emissive Probe System (XHINS-EP)
emissive.tagline: High SNR plasma potential and electron temperature
emissive.overview: Emissive probes yield higher accuracy for plasma potential and electron temperature; suitable for fine potential mapping. Supports visualized potential/temperature maps.
emissive.feature2: Higher SNR and potential resolution than standard LP
emissive.feature3: Compatible with various structures/materials for hot/complex flows
